decision_conditions:
<div><span style="font-size: 14.6667px; background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">The proposed development, by reason of scale, siting, design, bulk, mass and appearance would be an undesirable addition failing to preserve the existing character of the street scape and would not sit comfortable in the existing pattern of development. Specifically, the proposed side extension fails to preserve a gap between the terrace dwellings and would create a staggered roof form that would be significantly visible from public vantage points and would be visually intrusive, represent poor design and would be out of character in the context of the area.&nbsp; &nbsp;</span><span style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">As such, the proposed development is contrary to:</span></div><div><br></div><div><p><span style="font-size: 10.5pt; font-family: " pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="">-
